useWhen: Building a feature with quality-first approach
Ensuring high test coverage from the start

workflow.description: Write test first, define expected behavior before implementation exists
Write minimal code to get the test passing
Improve code quality while keeping tests passing
Continue the cycle for each behavior, building test coverage

examples.input: Implement a shopping cart using TDD. The cart should be able to add items, remove items, calculate total, and apply discount codes.
